og.alt: Content (@pyreon/zero-content): A typo in your frontmatter fails the build. Not your readers.

hero.alt: A Markdown post, hello.md, has a typo in its frontmatter: "titel" instead of "title". The frontmatter travels to the blog collection schema, the title check fails, and the build prints: hello.md: frontmatter does not match collection "blog" schema, title is missing. Fixed to "title", the build passes and writes the pages, search index, sitemap, RSS feed and llms.txt.

<title id="pq-content-t">A frontmatter typo fails the build, not the page</title>
<desc id="pq-content-d">A Markdown post, hello.md, has a typo in its frontmatter: "titel" instead of "title". The frontmatter travels to the blog collection schema, the title check fails, and the build prints: hello.md: frontmatter does not match collection "blog" schema, title is missing. Fixed to "title", the build passes and writes the pages, search index, sitemap, RSS feed and llms.txt.</desc>
